answer: Re-attestations are stored in beacon and copper lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, which means holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the quartz graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 374 impostors cost 1439 times the honest price and take 22 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
